title: Entire game/art/animations in Grok CLI
author: Nuvolore
selftext: 2 days ago I had this idea of building a game entirely on Grok CLI including the images and videos. This was all made with it, I never had to leave the terminal to adjust any of the images or animations. Pretty mind blowing!🤯 Cant wait to see what Grok 4.6 can do next week.
